question: In a Wheatstone bridge, the four arms have resistances $100\ \Omega$, $200\ \Omega$, $50\ \Omega$ and $S$. A moving coil galvanometer is connected between the middle points of the bridge. Determine the value of $S$ for which the galvanometer shows no deflection. Explain why no torque acts on the galvanometer coil in the balanced condition.

options.A: For balance, $\dfrac{P}{Q}=\dfrac{S}{R}$, giving $S=25\ \Omega$. Current flows through the galvanometer, so it experiences maximum torque.
options.B: The bridge is balanced for $S=50\ \Omega$. Although galvanometer current is zero, its coil experiences torque due to the magnetic field alone.
options.C: For a balanced bridge, $\dfrac{P}{Q}=\dfrac{R}{S}$. Thus $\dfrac{100}{200}=\dfrac{50}{S}$, giving $S=100\ \Omega$. At balance the galvanometer terminals have zero potential difference, so no current flows and the torque on its coil is zero.
options.D: The bridge balances for $S=200\ \Omega$. The galvanometer has no deflection because its coil carries a steady current.
